ev_board.reaction: Client reacted to a mood board

st_aiteam_intro: Helpers that do the busywork of the office. Switch on the ones you want.
st_app_redo: Can't get in? Set it up again
st_approve_intro: Approve or decline each piece. You can add a note; we see it right away.

st_ask_ph: A question or a comment for us…

st_canva_back: Done — the design is in the project.

st_design_soon: The design is on its way — you'll see boards and pictures here.

st_link_renewed: New link made. The old one no longer works.
st_message_ph: Hi! The living room board is ready for you to see…
st_name_ph: e.g. Casa Valle — living and dining
st_new_link_q: Make a new link? The one you sent stops working.
st_no_channel: Connect WhatsApp (or another channel) to send from here. Meanwhile, open WhatsApp with the message ready:

st_note_ph: A note, a decision, a photo from the site…

st_order_hint: Approved pieces become purchase orders, one per supplier.
st_other_apps: From SketchUp, Planner 5D or another app? Bring it in here →
st_pay_connect: Connect a payment provider to send payment links

st_preview_limit: That's the limit for today. Write to us and we'll show you more.
st_preview_next: Like it? Let's make it real.
st_preview_next_d: This is an AI sketch. In a visit we measure, listen and design it for how you live.

st_waiting_hint: The client approves them in their portal; send them the link.
